exposure: Medical education status (medical students/residents vs. non-medical college students)
outcome: Awareness of general medical risks of obesity
Awareness of reproductive risks of obesity
Motivation to lose weight before pregnancy
cohort: The study included a college-educated population consisting of 325 medical students/residents and 102 non-medical college students.
finding: The study found that both medical and non-medical college-educated populations had relatively low awareness of obesity-related reproductive risks compared to general risks, but over 90% expressed motivation to lose weight before pregnancy if informed.
